name: Heavy-Duty 2-Tier Industrial Metal Workbench
description: Need a rock-solid, zero-wobble workspace that can handle your heaviest gear? This high-quality, industrial-grade metal workbench is an absolute beast! Standing at a comfortable 1-meter high, it is perfectly optimized for standing projects, tech benchmarking, or as an ultra-stable 3D printer station. Features a heavy-duty all-metal reinforced frame with an incredibly practical lower/mid shelves for organized storage (perfect for hiding power strips, boxes, or printers). It also comes with built-in cable management oval cutouts to keep your wires perfectly routed. Rock-solid construction that will outlast any standard cheap desk!
contact_note: Extremely sturdy and in great shape. Perfect for garages, server room setups, or tech workshops. Please bring a vehicle large enough to transport a 4-foot assembled metal desk!
meta_description: Pre-owned heavy-duty 2-tier industrial metal workbench in good condition. 1m high, features built-in cable management and lower shelf storage.
name_zh: 1米高重型双层工业金属工作台/3D打印电脑桌
description_zh: 全网最稳固、拒绝任何摇晃的硬核全金属多功能工作桌！整体高度约为1米（39.4英寸），非常符合人体工学，站立操作或者搭配高脚椅都很舒适。全钢制加厚框架极其沉稳，作为电脑桌、3D打印机机位、甚至车库手工台都稳如泰山。自带中/下层隐藏式双层置物架，收纳空间惊人，同时后方配有标志性的双大号走线孔。用料扎实坚固，完爆任何市面普通木质电脑桌，成色良好。
